description: This Java class provides utility functions for creating and manipulating PyTorch tensors from Android Bitmap and Image sources, including normalization, cropping, rotation, and conversion to tensor format.

classes.name: TensorImageUtils
classes.description: Utility class for tensor creation from Android image sources, including normalization, cropping, rotation, and buffer management.

methods.name: bitmapToFloat32Tensor
methods.description: Creates a normalized tensor from a Bitmap with specified mean, std, and memory format.

methods.name: bitmapToFloatBuffer
methods.description: Writes normalized pixel data from a Bitmap into a FloatBuffer, with support for different memory formats.

methods.name: imageYUV420CenterCropToFloat32Tensor
methods.description: Creates a tensor from a YUV_420_888 Image with optional rotation, cropping, and normalization.

methods.name: imageYUV420CenterCropToFloatBuffer
methods.description: Writes pixel data from a YUV_420_888 Image into a FloatBuffer with optional rotation, cropping, and normalization.
